# Confirmation dossier — F-F3 (confirmation pipeline, 2026-08-11)

Status: MECHANISM CONFIRMED (source + executed, 4-DB matrix — the finding's first fresh PoC) ·
severity DEMOTED: recorded ~[score removed] [band removed] → **[band removed]** ([score removed] [band removed] is the AC:L ceiling, now
execution-backed) · record stays unproven/; rev-2 edits below.

## Kill-pair (fresh-context refuters)
- refuter-1: WEAKENED — mechanism STANDS (read-check-then-write; no FOR UPDATE; unconditional
  update; no affected-rows check); impact overstated ("amplification" capped at identity-equivalent
  tokens).
- kill-pair: CANNOT-KILL as a downgraded defect — KILL the claimed severity/impact: amplification
  REFUTED as a security gain (same-sub tokens, no jti, 1h bearer; token #1 already grants
  everything); NO victim in the race itself (self-only, same-authority); the true residual = the
  RFC 6749 §4.1.2 single-use violation. Program rule "some actual security impact in a realistic
  scenario" keeps the honest filing at [band removed].

## Executed evidence (final reviewer, raw jest stdout, node 24.14.1, pinned cfb9f07)
- revisit2-f3-max-impact.poc.test.ts: **16/16 PASS across 4 DBs** (after the orchestrator fixed a
  SQLite assertion that contradicted the suite's own header contract): (a) store-level atomicity
  defect 4/4; (b) concurrent redemption race — **1 code → 2× HTTP 200 + 2× issueToken, live, on
  real MySQL 8 + Postgres 14/18** (the first fresh proof on genuine MySQL 8 — phase-1 was MariaDB;
  SQLite serializes, recorded honestly); (c) approve-no-CAS double-code sibling (schema + concurrent
  approves, both codes redeem); (d) the missing-CAS negative control.
- Faithfulness: REAL OidcRouter → real HTTP → real OidcService → real OidcDatabase over migrated
  knex on sqlite/MySQL 8/Postgres 14/18; mocks = outer seams only (token issuer, auth, httpAuth,
  config, logger). Output is N×200 + N× issuer-call (signer mocked) — "valid tokens" framing struck.
- Record hygiene findings: the cited attempts (225505/225511/225518) are SCAFFOLDER stubs with the
  wrong hypothesis (zero OIDC content); the real attempts (attempts.jsonl seq 12-13, 17-18) are
  uncited; the 8/24 was an unasserted observation on MariaDB; the negative control cited was hollow.

## Gates
1. Independent refuters: ✅ 2 fresh-context (WEAKENED-with-caps / KILL-severity).
2. [score removed] [band removed]** — the AC:L variant computes
   4.3 (the race now demonstrated reliable) and IS the "~4.3" the original filing cited — reconciled.
3. Exact-path refs: ✅ 3/3 tokens resolved, hash-verified; proof chain mis-wiring corrected.
4. Secret scan: ✅ (lane report).
5. Corpus audit: ⛔ SYNTHETIC (shared operator decision).
6. New revision: ⛔ kernel duplicate (KRNL-DUP).

## Rev-2 edits for the honest per-link filing
- Re-wire the attempt refs to the REAL attempts (seq 12-13, 17-18); drop the hollow stubs.
- Drop the mocked-signer "valid tokens" framing (state: N× HTTP 200 + N× issuer calls).
- Correct the MariaDB-not-MySQL label (phase-1 host was MariaDB 12.3.2; THIS pass proves it on
  genuine MySQL 8 + Postgres).
- State the C:N/I:L 3.1 vector; note the 4.3 AC:L ceiling.

## Orchestrator adjudication: PROMOTE (mechanism-confirmed, [band removed]) — operator filing decision.

## RE-ESCALATION ADJUDICATION (2026-08-12) — band REVISED to [band removed] [score removed] [band removed] was 'not defensible against the record': better-auth and NocoDB carry the identical
read-then-markAsUsed primitive at [score removed] [band removed]; our race is now EXECUTION-proven (16/16 across 4 DBs,
1 code → 2× 200 + 2× issueToken on MySQL 8 + Postgres). AC:L is execution-backed. Final:
[vector removed] = [score removed] [band removed]. Not 6.5+: same-sub tokens, no victim in the
race itself (the victim exists only in the N3 composition, which is N3's own impact — filing F3
with it would double-count).

## ⚠️ WITHDRAWN (2026-08-12) — re-escalation note rescinded
The re-escalation raise recorded above is WITHDRAWN following the independent audit: the pass was
driven by a leading prompt with no kill side, and the raise's precedent basis was misquoted
(verified: ArcadeDB dropped at severity-precedent-corpus.md:69; NocoDB 8.1 matches no public
source). The band reverts to the confirmation-pipeline value. A symmetric kill-pair re-audit with
correct re-fetched precedents is required before any re-raise. See
evidence/revisit-2026-08-11/92-re-escalation-audit.md.

## SYMMETRIC RE-AUDIT (2026-08-12) — FINAL BAND: [band removed] (AC:L)
Both re-audit lanes converge on 4.3: the pro-escalation concedes the impact analysis entirely
(C:N/I:L — amplification refuted, same-sub tokens, no victim), and the pro-demotion concedes the
AC:L ceiling on the executed evidence. The band change from 3.1 is justified by symmetric
agreement, not directional pressure: the demotion killed impact but retained pre-execution AC:H —
the same AC-vs-impact category error it attributed to the 4.3 raise. Vector:
[vector removed]. Nothing above 4.3 (both sides agree). See
evidence/revisit-2026-08-11/93-symmetric-reaudit.md.
